title: Solution, projects, startup, and local IIS Express
summary: HQ.sln contains HQ, HQBackSite, and HQBackSite.Tests. HQ is MVC/Web API on .NET Framework 4.6.1 and local port 14555. HQBackSite is MVC on .NET Framework 4.7.2 and local port 57568.
risk: Verify physical paths before starting services so the old project folder is not launched by mistake.

title: Web.config names and app settings without secrets
summary: Both sites define named SQL Server connection strings and appSettings. HQ uses TestingMode for URL behavior. HQBackSite uses EnableLocalLoginDebug and LocalBootstrapAccounts for local login/debug support.
risk: Do not embed full connection strings, passwords, JWT signing keys, cookie values, or tokens in RAG output.

title: HQ bundle and routing setup
summary: HQ registers jQuery, util, modernizr, bootstrap, CSS bundles plus layout and dept script bundles. MVC defaults to Hq/index and Web API defaults to api/controller/action/id.
risk: Changing bundle names can break Razor views that call Scripts.Render.

title: HQ employee portal home page
summary: The HQ home page is server-rendered Razor with client-side DOM assembly in Index.js. It calls Main, Ics, and Marquee APIs for home blocks, documents, links, and announcements.
risk: Most API responses are DataSet-shaped. Field name changes can silently break jQuery rendering.

title: HQ department and branch pages
summary: Department and branch pages render tabs, page content, downloads, department news, branch letters, system notices, and new data through Dept.js and DeptController.
risk: Store English-name mapping and old/new newsletter fallback are embedded in code; verify branch-specific behavior before refactoring.

title: Legacy phone directory and static Home pages
summary: Legacy Home pages include static/exported pages and a large DHTML menu script. Phone directory functions call ValuesController for store and employee phone search.
risk: ValuesController.SqlString builds large dynamic SQL strings; prioritize parameterization and narrow regression testing.

title: Static IT member page
summary: Static IT department member and responsibility page served directly by HQ. It includes UTF-8 meta to avoid mojibake.
risk: Direct static HTML bypasses MVC layout and bundle behavior; encoding must be handled inside the file or web server headers.

title: Old HQ Backside login and pages
summary: Old Backside authenticates against Users and issues a FormsAuthentication ticket. Protected page actions return Razor views that use Backside JavaScript files.
risk: This auth is separate from HQBackSite Authorization JWT cookie; do not mix assumptions.

title: Old Backside Page Unit Content CRUD
summary: Old Backside Page/Unit/Content management is jQuery-driven and talks to HQ Web API CRUD controllers using DataSet/int responses.
risk: APIs are broadly reachable and rely on client-side UI for workflow; inspect authorization and validation before changing write operations.

title: Old Backside news, safe, and HR CRUD
summary: Old Backside uses NewsController for generic news, security announcements with type msg1, and HR announcements with type msg2.
risk: News types drive different front-end blocks; changing type/dept semantics affects HQ home.

title: MainController HtmlScraper and link extraction
summary: HtmlScraper downloads a URL, detects PDF vs HTML, extracts candidate document links using iTextSharp, AngleSharp, and regex fallback helpers.
risk: Current error response may expose stack traces. External URL handling needs SSRF and timeout review before expansion.

title: MainController homepage document and cache APIs
summary: MainController joins old webmax6 data with newer Newsletter data, renders home lists, reads active news blocks, updates count, and can clear MemoryCache.
risk: ReleaseAllCache has side effects and accepts GET/POST. Several cache hit branches are disabled by constant false conditions.

title: Room, ICS, and Marquee APIs
summary: Support APIs provide left-side department/menu data, education user CRUD, front-facing ICS list, and active marquee data for the HQ home page.
risk: Room write endpoints and front-facing ICS/marquee data should be smoke tested from their JS callers.

title: HQBackSite login, Authorization cookie, and authorization filter
summary: HQBackSite login validates an account path, issues an Authorization JWT cookie, and protected controllers use BackSiteAuthorize to validate it and look up users.
risk: Do not expose JWT signing key. AD verification code exists but is not active in the current login path.

title: HQBackSite BaseController and shared models
summary: HQBackSite centralizes JSON response formatting and Dapper DB helpers in BaseController. Models are mostly table/view DTOs used by MenuController and Razor views.
risk: BaseController logs SQL context on DB errors; ensure logs do not leak sensitive values.

title: HQBackSite menu setting and permission actions
summary: Menu setting manages para type 1050 department/branch entries. Permission actions assign employee ids to code_name and expose menu-code permissions to the browser.
risk: Existing permission doc may drift from code; verify current action names and menu codes before changing permissions.

title: HQBackSite category and content management
summary: New back-office category and content management works with para/code_name permissions, content subtype/category data, CKEditor, and common upload handling.
risk: Content URL/file mode toggles are split between Razor and content.js. Update tests when validation or upload behavior changes.

title: HQBackSite message management
summary: New back-office message management stores and updates news records with editor-backed content and date/status fields.
risk: Message records share the news table with HQ homepage, security, HR, banner, and ICS records; preserve type/dept semantics.

title: HQBackSite ICS management and front-facing ICS data
summary: HQBackSite writes ICS news plus detail rows in ics_list/ics_upload. HQ front home reads active ICS data through IcsController.
risk: ICSAdd/ICSUpdate parse JSON strings from form fields; validate shape and deleted flags before changing.

title: HQBackSite Word upload to static HTML preview
summary: WordHtmlTest uploads .docx files, MenuController saves them, WordHtmlConverter converts OOXML to HTML, and WordHtmlPreview serves generated UTF-8 HTML by safe file name pattern.
risk: GeneratedHtml is runtime output and should not be committed. Keep preview file-name validation tight.

title: HQBackSite layout, common JS, and styles
summary: HQBackSite UI behavior is centralized in shared layouts, lib.js, menu.js, login.js, content.js, and Site.css.
risk: Views depend on global functions from lib.js; avoid renaming helpers without scanning Razor inline scripts.

title: HQBackSite MSTest regression suite
summary: The test suite targets HQBackSite behavior around Word HTML conversion, MenuController Word endpoints, content management, and ICS management.
risk: No direct HQ Web API/front-end tests are present. State manual smoke-test gaps when changing HQ.

title: HelpPage and UEditor vendor/generated areas
summary: HelpPage is Web API scaffold. UEditor includes an ASP.NET handler, config, upload/list/crawler handlers, and third-party editor assets. jQuery/Bootstrap/Modernizr are vendor files.
risk: Do not refactor vendor files unless the task explicitly targets the vendor integration boundary.

title: Generated HTML, userfiles, images, and static exports
summary: Runtime/generated/static asset areas contain generated Word HTML previews, uploaded user files, images, legacy content images, and Excel-exported tel pages.
risk: Do not commit generated previews or untracked Thumbs.db files. Confirm ownership before editing uploaded content.
